Problem Statement
Read an integer N and print a message N times, using a function that takes N as a parameter and uses a loop.
Description
Read an integer N from input. Write a void function print Message that takes one integer parameter times and uses a for loop to print the message "Learning C is fun" exactly that many times, each on its own line. Call this function from main() by passing N.
Input Description
A single integer N (N >= 1).
Output Description
Print the message "Learning C is fun" N times, each on a new line.
Sample Input
3
